summary: UV-5R owner: Android Bluetooth sees and pairs the Tidradio adapter, but NewChirp's scan never shows it. The app only lists advertising devices (service filter, then unfiltered after 4 s); an adapter already connected by the system usually stops advertising. Workaround: forget it in Android settings and connect from the app. Possible fix: also list system-connected devices (UniversalBle.getSystemDevices).
title: Android app does not list the adapter after it was paired in Android settings
